# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta17

This beta changes History session selection from an isolation view into a non-destructive glow overlay.

## Changed

- Use the same configured `trail_color` for the active session, current-day mowing geometry and completed History session areas.
- Keep the existing `trail_color` and `trail_opacity` controls in the card editor; no new History-only color setting is introduced.
- Keep all current-day / selected-day mowing geometry visible when a session time is selected.
- Add the selected session as a separate glow overlay instead of replacing or hiding the other session geometry.
- Fix the Single mower glow selector: the SVG layer is `.nm-highlight`, not the old non-existent `.nm-session-highlight` selector.
- Apply the same overlay behavior in Multi mower view, including keeping current-cycle zone artifacts and live trail geometry visible while a completed session glows.
- Keep session selection scoped to the selected mower/session; only the emphasis changes.

## Visual behavior

The normal mowing geometry keeps the configured opacity. The selected session uses the same base hue and receives a temporary pulse/drop-shadow glow above the still-visible day geometry.

## Compatibility

No backend contract change is required beyond the existing Navimower integration APIs. Semantic live-route support from 0.3.7-beta16 remains unchanged.
